body: Run Java and pipeline in developer and run script

@snooppr, the packages module has always been an internal Requests detail which previously housed vendored copies of those packages. That hasn't been true for ~7 years and anything under there is not intended to support mutation. If you want to override values, you should be doing it directly through the modules.

That said, `DEFAULT_CIPHERS`  no longer exists in urllib3, which is why you're having issues. Your problem is not related to Requests, but rather the[ removal of this in urllib3 2.x](https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/blob/10ae8a9c1a88e4c1581d291395b2902e9c9fab36/CHANGES.rst?plain=1#L326) (which was first supported in Requests 2.31.0).

Can you explain how to pull the proper updated to incorporate.

Pamela J Richardson
